entries.title: 3b1b Manim
entries.observed_pattern: engine and scene code are separated; examples are first navigation surface
entries.transferable_rule: keep deterministic scene entry points separate from the film factory
entries.rejection_rule: no decorative scene without runnable source

entries.title: Three.js
entries.observed_pattern: browsable examples catalog with small runnable witnesses
entries.transferable_rule: each film scene needs a browsable source witness
entries.rejection_rule: no visual without source and receipt link

entries.title: Mapbox Storytelling
entries.observed_pattern: chapters bind camera state to callbacks
entries.transferable_rule: EON chapters must own camera waypoints and state transitions
entries.rejection_rule: no anonymous timeline or camera jump

entries.title: Flow Story
entries.observed_pattern: waypoints and annotated 3D transitions are data-driven
entries.transferable_rule: camera choreography is a manifest, not ad-hoc animation
entries.rejection_rule: no waypoint without source pointer and reversible QA

entries.title: Genblaze
entries.observed_pattern: manifest-driven media pipeline with shared producer schemas
entries.transferable_rule: ImageGen outputs stay provider-neutral and feed deterministic stages
entries.rejection_rule: no generated asset without provenance manifest

entries.title: Google 3D Storytelling
entries.observed_pattern: config-driven chapters bind story metadata to initial camera and 3D scene
entries.transferable_rule: HERAKLES chapters must be data objects with camera state
entries.rejection_rule: no chapter without explicit camera and source pointer

entries.title: MapLibre Storymaps
entries.observed_pattern: scroll-driven chapters control terrain and camera from a client-side manifest
entries.transferable_rule: camera transitions belong to chapter data, not hidden timing

entries.title: Data2Motion
entries.observed_pattern: compact JSON spec drives deterministic chart animation, replay, reduced motion and QA hooks
entries.transferable_rule: film scenes need replayable JSON specs and machine QA
entries.rejection_rule: no visual output without spec and replay path

entries.title: Chrome accessibility guidance
entries.observed_pattern: prefers-reduced-motion is treated as an explicit animation mode
entries.transferable_rule: every film preview and World chapter needs reduced-motion behavior
entries.rejection_rule: no release with decorative motion that cannot be reduced

entries.title: TaleCrafter
entries.observed_pattern: story visualization preserves identity, text-visual alignment and local structure
entries.transferable_rule: HERAKLES objects retain identity across film frames
entries.rejection_rule: reject identity break or text-image mismatch

entries.title: Story Ribbons
entries.observed_pattern: narrative parsing becomes multi-level trajectory visualization
entries.transferable_rule: EON chapters can expose trajectory and theme layers separately
entries.rejection_rule: reject flattened narrative without level markers

entries.title: D3 Storytelling Viz
entries.observed_pattern: one state carries one insight and one transition carries one meaning change
entries.transferable_rule: each film beat gets one visual claim
entries.rejection_rule: reject transitions that change multiple unrelated meanings

entries.title: Genblaze multi-provider sample
entries.observed_pattern: image anchor iterates then fans out to multiple video providers under one lineage
entries.transferable_rule: ImageGen references can branch, but all promoted assets share a parent manifest

entries.title: Hyperframes pipeline
entries.observed_pattern: capture, design, script, storyboard, voiceover, build and validate are named artifacts
entries.transferable_rule: every film phase emits a named JSON artifact
entries.rejection_rule: reject phase transitions without artifact handoff

entries.title: Mayavi
entries.observed_pattern: scriptable scientific 3D visualization remains reusable and embeddable
entries.transferable_rule: World geometry must have a scriptable, reproducible scene path
entries.rejection_rule: reject scene that only exists as a screenshot

entries.title: Good Story
entries.observed_pattern: scientific storytelling explicitly tests evidence strength and overclaim risk
entries.transferable_rule: film narration must expose evidence limits, not polish weak claims
entries.rejection_rule: reject any sentence whose falsifier is absent

entries.title: D3 Storytelling Viz state grammar
entries.observed_pattern: state-based transitions preserve data keys for continuity
entries.transferable_rule: object identity keys persist across camera and scene transitions
entries.rejection_rule: reject visual relabeling that breaks key continuity

entries.title: MDN prefers-reduced-motion
entries.observed_pattern: reduced-motion is a runtime preference that changes animation behavior
entries.transferable_rule: film preview and World UI expose a reduced-motion path
entries.rejection_rule: reject essential information encoded only in motion
